posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Baby Vihaan's first photo with parents Katrina and Vicky breaks the internet. The new mom is glowing and fans can't get enough of the adorable family moments.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Main Vaapas Aaunga released June 12 with AR Rahman's score. Sardaar Ji 3 drops June 27, and his Madison Square Garden show sold out in minutes.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha teaser dropped June 10 — Alia enters the YRF Spy Universe as a fierce new agent. The action-packed thriller releases July 3 and fans are hyped.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: PeeCee is in Mumbai for brother Siddharth's pre-wedding celebrations. Meanwhile, her Varanasi-set epic with SS Rajamouli continues to build buzz.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King is shooting for a Christmas 2026 release with Deepika and Suhana. SRK gave Alia a sweet shoutout for Alpha and is reportedly eyeing a romantic drama next.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Bebo wrapped Daayra and was spotted at an Aamir Khan event. Buzz is building around her role in Yash's Toxic, making 2026 a packed year for the queen.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Eetha locks August 28 release — Shraddha's next big horror comedy. She's also been cleared in a long-running drug case, closing that chapter for good.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announced her second pregnancy in April and is juggling King and Raaka shoots with a body double. She's proudly flaunting the baby bump on social media.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Don 3 exit drama and a FWICE ban made headlines. Dhurandhar franchise is heading to Japan, and Ranveer is acquiring film rights to Amish Tripathi's Immortals of Meluha.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stunned at Cannes 2026 in blush pink couture, with daughter Aaradhya joining her on the red carpet. Mother-daughter goals at the French Riviera.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Cocktail 2 promotions are in full swing and Mysaa is shooting. The newlywed (married Vijay Deverakonda in Feb) is balancing love and back-to-back films.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Maa Inti Bangaaram trailer is out and fans are loving it. Samantha married director Raj Nidimoru in Dec 2025 and is glowing in her new chapter.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Raaka with Atlee and Deepika is in production, and AA23 with Lokesh Kanagaraj just got announced. Bunny also praised Ram Charan's Peddi — Telugu cinema's MVP stays busy.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi crossed ₹260 Cr worldwide in its first week — Ram Charan's biggest solo hit ever. Some controversy over Janhvi Kapoor scenes, but the box office speaks.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Dragon glimpse unveiled to massive hype. War 2 teaser with Hrithik has fans counting days, and NTR is reuniting with Trivikram for another blockbuster.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Peddi success with Ram Charan earned her a career-best ₹8 Cr paycheque and a 100% Telugu hit ratio. Next up: Raaka with Allu Arjun and Lag Ja Gale with Tiger Shroff.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya hit theaters and Call Me Bae Season 2 is returning on Prime Video. She exited Choomantar due to scheduling conflicts.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Toxic with Yash postponed for a bigger global rollout. She's set to headline the Madhubala biopic with Bhansali producing, and opened up about her postpartum journey with baby Saraayah.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Signed with Hollywood agency Anonymous Content. Krrish 4 is his directorial debut shooting this summer for a 2027 release, and HRX Films' Storm series is in production.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai released June 5 with Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde — a classic David Dhawan rom-com and possibly his father's final directorial.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: The Unstoppable world tour is rolling through 21 cities across 6 countries. Won Best Playback Singer at Pinkvilla Awards 2026, and purchased a ₹29.7 Cr Worli home.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Scored Main Vaapas Aaunga (released June 12) and the Ramayana soundtrack with Hans Zimmer. His Royal Albert Hall debut with Rangreza got rave reviews.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Jana Nayagan — his final film before full-time politics — hit censor delays and a major leak controversy. Mersal is re-releasing June 19 for his 52nd birthday.
